how_to_read.questions: For Recall@5 and MRR. A retrieved chunk is a HIT if its scheme_id is in expected_scheme_ids AND its section_type is in expected_sections. Section types: description, eligibility, exclusions, benefits, documents, how_to_apply.
how_to_read.profiles: For eligibility accuracy. The description goes through the full pipeline (profile extraction + rule check). expected_likely_eligible and expected_needs_confirmation follow the OFFICIAL criteria (not our rules); every other scheme is expected to be 'Not eligible'. The startup-playbook is a guide, not a scheme, so it is not scored.
how_to_read.out_of_scope: Questions with out_of_scope=true have no correct scheme. The answer must say the information was not found and must not invent details. They are used only for the correct refusal rate.
